deployments_detail.use: Firm-wide use of generative AI for back-office operations including automatic summarization of internal documents and assistance in report writing, as disclosed in Nomura's FY2025 annual report / IT & Digital Strategy section. [none]

Establishment of dedicated AI Centers of Excellence (AI CoE), including an International AI CoE set up in April 2025 combining Japan and global-office AI initiatives, to govern and scale AI adoption across Japan and international businesses. [none]

Use of Meta Llama models via Amazon Bedrock for text summarization and code generation, as part of a firm-wide effort to democratize generative AI access to employees and developers. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock), Meta Llama]
"Japan AI CoE" (Apr 2024) + "Core AI Platform" (multi-LLM, AWS Bedrock) for compliance/ad review; OpenAI strategic alliance (Nov 2024)

"Core AI" — an in-house generative AI platform (launched 2023) built on AWS with multi-LLM orchestration, a fact-based execution layer, multimodal support, and Snowflake for company-wide data. Serves as the firm-wide foundation for genAI applications across Nomura Group. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock), Anthropic Claude, Snowflake]

AIM2 'ORCA/AI Trader' AI trading technology deployed globally across Nomura's flow/market-making businesses (fixed income, swaps, credit, FX) to augment quantitative and market-making capabilities. AIM2 was a Nomura/Brevan Howard JV; tech acquired by SparkCognition in 2021 with Nomura continuing global rollout. [AIM2 / SparkCognition]

Strategic collaboration with OpenAI to advance asset management: adopting OpenAI Deep Research and OpenAI technical support to develop AI-driven investment advice, market analysis, and data solutions for clients, combining Nomura's proprietary data with external datasets. [OpenAI (Deep Research)]

"Ideation Accelerator" built on Core AI — assigns different personas to multiple LLMs for collaborative brainstorming and synthesizes the outputs into press-release-ready formats, supporting content/marketing workflows. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock), Anthropic Claude]

Ad Review AI: automated compliance checking of financial advertising via Core AI — grammar verification, detection of exaggerated/definitive language, and alignment with Japan Securities Dealers Association guidelines, addressing bottlenecks in high-volume monthly ad reviews. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock), Anthropic Claude (progressed Claude 2 to Claude 3 Opus)]
